description: Declared mutants of the naming guard's namespace roots (v8-arch-gyo2-namespace-root; rebuild-naming N17, naming DI 1; ids nm-). The guard is tests/common/kernel/naming_guard.py; its older mutants stay in the kernel, orchestration and world_time lists (ks-n1-*, ks-n3-*, or-guard-*, wt-guard-real-*). A self-test mutant is killed only when the named test case fails; a real-tree mutant when the guard prints the named finding. The adversarial check and the design review (another model, read-only) is recorded in the dev_log.

mutants.what: the acronym table is empty, so io and os are expected as Io and Os. Only it catches the acronym list (each item is pinned by test_acronyms_are_io_and_os)

real tree, positive control of the derived namespace on a core unit: an os source opens GYO::Engine::Os (the spelling the user turned down). Only it shows a core unit checked on the real tree; ks-real-old-namespace is the kernel's, or-/wt-guard-real-n1-other-namespace orchestration's and world_time's
